Bootstraps config, logging, and action dispatch for command-line subcommands.

# Purpose
This file implements the main boot and command dispatch path for the application. It defines `fd_main()` and `fd_main_init()`, which parse command line arguments, select an `action_t` from `ACTIONS[]`, load configuration data, and initialize logging, shared memory, and tile runtime state before the selected command runs. It also handles early exit commands such as `--help` and `--version`, and it enforces command permissions through `fd_cap_chk_t` before calling the action function.

The file also contains support code for startup tasks. `copy_config_from_fd()` reads a `config_t` from a file descriptor with `mmap()`, `map_log_memfd()` maps the shared log lock page, `init_log_memfd()` creates the memfd used for log sequencing, and `should_colorize()` selects terminal color output from environment variables. `determine_override_config()` selects built-in override configuration data for `--testnet`, `--devnet`, or `--mainnet`, and `fdctl_tile_run()` maps a topology tile name to its runtime tile record in `TILES[]`.
